description: Fixed the critical scalar parameter initialization bug in the GPT class where `y` and `x0_lambdas` were incorrectly assigned to class variables (`self.y`, `self.x0`) instead of the forward pass parameters (`self.x`, `self.x0`) during the forward pass. This caused the MuonAdamW optimizer to fail initialization on the first step (val_bpb = 0.9910 -> 0.9942), turning a stable training into a 5-minute crash.
